blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Don't sacrifice great taste for great health. Lifeable gummy vitamins and supplements are bursting with nutrients and fruit flavors so you will actually enjoy taking them. Lifeable - Health gone tasty!

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: As a dietary supplement, children 2-3 years old take one (1) gummy per day, children 4 years old and up take two [2] gummies per day. Chew thoroughly before swallowing.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Glucose syrup, sugar, water, pectin, colors (black carrot concentrate, sodium copper chlorophyllin, curcumin and paprika extract), trisodium citrate, natural flavors, sodium ascorbate, carnauba wax, choline tartrate.
Does not contain eggs, wheat (gluten), milk, peanuts, tree nuts, sesame, soy, or shellfish. Produced in a nut free facility.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Do not exceed suggested serving size. If you have a medical condition, are taking medication, or are pregnant or nursing, ask a doctor before using.
Not for children under 2 years of age due to risk of choking.
Do not use this product if safety seal under cap is torn or missing.
Keep out of reach of children.
